newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil crushers expect 100,000T US soybean Dec.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil crushers expect 100,000T US soybean Dec.

text.p: About 100,000 tonnes of US soybean is expected to arrive at Thai ports between December and early January, trade and shipping sources said Thursday.
The Thai Cottonseed, Ricebran and Vegetable Oil Crushers Association was said to be the buyer and Louis Dreyfus the supplier.
The vessel Yick Kam had left the Gulf of Mexico with 47,000 tonnes of soybean and was expected to arrive on December 5.
Vessel Avalanche was scheduled to load 50,000 tonnes of soybean between November 28 and December 5 and was likely to arrive by the end of December or early January.
